title: Insurance claim routing
goal: Show first-notice-of-loss routing by claim value, type, fraud indicators, and repair needs.

rubric.must: The root visibly splits claims by the fast-track value threshold.
High-value injury-or-liability claims visibly route to a complex casualty adjuster.
High-value non-injury claims with fraud indicators visibly route to special investigations.
Low-value claims covered by automated rules visibly route to fast-track settlement.
The non-automated low-value path visibly distinguishes repair-network coordination from standard handling.
Each terminal handling path is visibly labelled with a distinct operational destination.

ideal.notes: Redrawn from the source with the independent taxonomy exemplar drawing script; no engine geometry or screenshot used to build the target.

review.evidence: Visually reviewed against the taxonomy exemplar and source: complete questions and outcomes, numbered hexagons, unambiguous Yes/No drops, and a shared outcome row. No clipped labels or material collisions. Unclassified outcomes remain neutral.
